proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ μ _ A B hA hB hPA _
  have h1 : (ProbabilityTheory.cond μ A).real B * μ.real A = μ.real (A ∩ B) := by
    simp only [MeasureTheory.Measure.real]
    rw [← ENNReal.toReal_mul, ProbabilityTheory.cond_mul_eq_inter hA B μ]
  have h2 : (ProbabilityTheory.cond μ B).real A * μ.real B = μ.real (B ∩ A) := by
    simp only [MeasureTheory.Measure.real]
    rw [← ENNReal.toReal_mul, ProbabilityTheory.cond_mul_eq_inter hB A μ]
  rw [eq_div_iff hPA.ne', h1, h2, Set.inter_comm]
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A B : Set Ω), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → 0 < μ.real A → 0 < μ.real B → (ProbabilityTheory.cond μ A).real B = (ProbabilityTheory.cond μ B).real A * μ.real B / μ.real A
